scope: Headless scripted reference fixture; six supplied tier-II weapons, neutral character effects, Danger0 and engine-specific RNG. Survival mode accepts natural defeat only after the source retry/OK acknowledgment; a loss is NOT twenty completed waves. Health values are net changes sampled per physics callback, not every hit/heal event. No captures, human play, ordinary input/focus or visual/audio validation. Explicit matched safe-loadout acquisition policy: positive periodic self-damage offers skipped and such crates recycled; no production damage changes. Historical original campaign used unfiltered choices.
